free_tier.stated: No free tier: fixed monthly resource packages, with a new-user discount on the first paid plan. The Starter package is the entry point: regular price $34, new user price $7/ month on the first paid plan, with 2 vCPU, 2Gi RAM, 10Gi Disk, 10GB Traffic, 4 NodePorts and 100 AI Credits. There is no USD 0 plan.

limits.value: a fixed monthly package rather than metered billing: the entry Starter package is 2 vCPU, 2 GiB RAM, 10 GiB disk and 10 GB traffic; the Hobby package is 4 vCPU, 4 GiB RAM, 20 GiB disk and 50 GB traffic
the package's disk and traffic are the ceilings, and platform credits are spent separately

limits_note: Session cap, idle-reap and network policy are not documented. No rate published.

Details of what the signup form asks for are unverified from the pages read.
